verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state evaluators can run on live production traces, not just offline datasets ('You can run evaluations on traces from production, on experiment results, or on any dataset'), and traces are ingested continuously via OTLP for scoring with LLM-judge or code-based evaluators. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/automated continuous eval jobs on streaming production traffic (vs. on-demand runs) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
